metadata.description: Layer e: compute_spectrum with FiniteDifferenceSolver() and spectrum_levels(2)
metadata.float_format: shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 double (exact when parsed as float64); non-finite -> null
metadata.units: masses/energies GeV, r GeV^-1, p GeV

notes.call: compute_spectrum(params, Meson(mq, flavor1, flavor2); levels=spectrum_levels(2), solver) = add_intra_meson_mixing(fixed_spectrum(...))
notes.flavors: light quark symbol is :q (u/d average, 0.220 GeV); :u gives the same mass. 'uc' is Meson(mq,:u,:c), i.e. m1=m_u, m2=m_c (swapped order)
notes.state.mass_GeV: final (mixed) mass; corrected_mass_GeV is the fixed-sector eigenvalue before mixing; central+contact+fine_structure = corrected_mass
notes.mixings: one record per mixing step (StateMixing); components = column `eigenstate` of block_vectors in basis partner_labels; offdiag_GeV = max |offdiag| of the block; partner_masses_GeV = ascending block eigenvalues
notes.convergence: HO only: convergence(spec,state) per physical component
notes.sector_solutions: HO only: every cached fixed (L,S,J) sector: eigenvalues and OscillatorConvergence (beta, nbasis)
